acceptance_criteria: EngineeringResult carries one new field reporting developer attempts remaining, populated from EngineeringJob.corrections_remaining and nothing reimplemented
the CEO page's plain-text rendering shows the new field beside the existing developer attempts line
the new field round-trips through to_dict and from_mapping like every other result field
a focused test in tests/test_company_engineering_execution.py or tests/test_company_runtime.py proves the field's value and its presence on the rendered page
no existing test in the required suites regresses
implementation_summary: Added `developer_attempts_remaining: int` to `EngineeringResult`, populated in `build()` directly from `job.corrections_remaining` (no arithmetic reimplemented), and shown on the CEO page alongside the existing developer attempts line as `developer attempts: N  remaining: M`. The field round-trips through `to_dict` (via `to_jsonable`) and `from_mapping` identically to every other integer field.
objective: The CEO result page (EngineeringResult) reports how many developer attempts a job has used (developer_attempts) but never how many remain against the work order's own authorized ceiling, so reading the page requires separately looking up max_developer_attempts and subtracting by hand every time. Add a field to EngineeringResult reporting the developer attempts remaining, populated from the job's own existing corrections_remaining property (do not reimplement the arithmetic), and show it on the CEO page's text rendering next to the existing developer attempts line.
review_findings: [advisory] duplicate-section-15-comment: Two consecutive test sections are both numbered '15' — the new section and the pre-existing CEO-surface section share the same header label.

[advisory] historical-record-default-zero: from_mapping defaults developer_attempts_remaining to 0, so stored results serialized before this change will silently report 0 remaining even when that was not the actual state at the time.
risks: Stored results serialized before this change will deserialize with developer_attempts_remaining=0 (the from_mapping default), which is correct for any job that has exhausted its attempts but misleading for a mid-loop snapshot that was stored without the field; a reviewer should confirm whether historical result records matter.
